_comment: Every rule about what Ethan may do, in one file. Read only by ethan/policy.py.
doors: what each way in may do. classes: the privacy classes it may file into
(a door not listed, or with no classes, files nowhere). relay: may pass an ask to a
running coding session. build: may start a hand through sky build.
actions: allow (done when asked), ask (done only when the person says so in the
ask itself), never (refused, whoever asks). For every act but relay_implementation,
allow and ask mean the same. Each is enforced where it takes effect: remind in the
clock, read_ledger in status, relay_review_only and relay_implementation in relay,
watch in watch, phone in reach, file_to_kb in harvest. The last three are promises
Ethan keeps by having no code path for them; tests/test_policy.py checks that stays
true, and tries every never and every ask.
